examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā vaṅg'īso sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā vaṅg'īso acira-arahattappatto hutvā vimuttisukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedī tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi

890.commentary: (MNa) acirakāritaṃ hotī'ti kaṭṭhakamma-silākamma-cittakamm'ādi-vasena susajjitaṃ devavimānaṃ viya adhunā niṭṭhāpitaṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.

891.commentary: (MNa) acirapakkantassā'ti pakkantassa sato nacirena. (MNa) acirapakkanto'ti vibbhamitvā gihibhāv'ūpagamanena adhunāpakkanto.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu pāṭaligāmikesu upāsakesu suññ'āgāraṃ pāvisi
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sakamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā ciravippavuttho assa. so aññataraṃ purisaṃ passeyya tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā acirapakkantaṃ.
ye te, ānanda, bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhun'āgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, te vo, ānanda, bhikkhū pañcasu dhammesu samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā
ahaṃ kho, āvuso, navo acirapabbajito adhun'āgato imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ. na t'āhaṃ sakkomi vitthārena ācikkhituṃ.
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati ukkacelāyaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ aciraparinibbutesu sāriputtamoggallānesu.

896.construction:
na > a + cira + vant + a
aciravant + a

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, jayaseno rājakumāro aciravataṃ samaṇ'uddesaṃ etadavoca, aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bho aggivessana, anavakāso yaṃ bhikkhu appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto phuseyya cittassa ek'aggatan'ti.

897.meaning1: name of a river; one of the five great rivers of ancient India
897.construction:
na > a + cira + vant + tī
aciravant + tī

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyath'idaṃ gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddo'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vāseṭṭha, api nu tassa purisassa avhāyanahetu vā āyācanahetu vā patthanahetu vā abhinandanahetu vā aciravatiyā nadiyā pārimaṃ tīraṃ orimaṃ tīraṃ āgaccheyyā'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.

899.meaning1: recently disrobed; recently left the community

examples.text: paripakke gabbhe vibbhamitvā vijāyi. bhikkhuniyo thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavocuṃ, sundarīnandā kho, ayye, aciravibbhantā vijātā. kacci no sā bhikkhunī'y'eva samānā gabbhinī'ti?
